description: GDROM v2: An Inventory of Operation Variables Time Series and Rules for 2,017 Large Reservoirs across the CONUS is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Zheng, Zihan (deposited on HydroShare). Effective reservoir operation is used to pursue multiple water management objectives, while also representing a major human intervention in hydrologic processes. Yet for most reservoirs, the lack of complete daily operation records and realistic accurate operation rules constrains their representation in large-scale hydrological models. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2025-07-21 and last updated 2025-09-29; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
